name: Ukikura
displayVersion: 1.0.6 (Patch 53 - Fix Locked node.exe File Access & Windows Job Object Process Auto-Kill)
author: Nauflix
changelog: Ukikura v1.0.6 (Patch 53 - Perbaikan File Lock node.exe & Integrasi Windows Job Object): 1) Memperbaiki galat instalasi 'DeleteFile failed; code 5. Access is denied' pada runtime/node.exe dengan menambahkan pembersihan proses otomatis di InitializeSetup dan PrepareToInstall Inno Setup. 2) Menerapkan Windows Job Object (JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE) pada host native Rust agar proses child background node.exe dan ukikura-bridge.exe otomatis mati tuntas saat Ukikura ditutup.
